title_en: Gaza remains recovery points to possible war crimes, says UN rights chief
excerpt_en: Bodies are still being pulled from the rubble of Gaza, three years after Israeli bombardment flattened entire neighbourhoods – most of them women and children.

title_en: Why is pro-Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil suing Columbia University?
excerpt_en: Mahmoud Khalil sues Columbia University and its dean for alleged institutional racism targeting pro-Palestine students.

title_en: Israeli minister threatens to revoke filmmakers' citizenship over Gaza documentary
excerpt_en: The film accuses the Israeli army of mass civilian killing in Gaza, and Israeli officials say it could be treasonous.

title_en: Six UN staff killed in Gaza school strike; Lebanon violations mount
excerpt_en: Israeli strikes killed six UN workers and civilians at a school sheltering displaced families in Gaza as needs grow, according to the UN agency for Palestine refugees, UNRWA.

title_en: ‘Where do we go?’: How Israel’s ‘yellow line’ is closing in on Palestinians
excerpt_en: Ola Ishtiwi sits with her children in front of the remains of her home in the Al-Tuffah neighbourhood in eastern Gaza City, a few metres away from a series of painted cement blocks Israel has placed to mark what has become known as the “yellow line”.

title_en: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
excerpt_en: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.

title_en: In West Bank, date farmers weigh impact of UK sanctions on Israeli settlers
excerpt_en: Palestinians strongly back a ban on settlement goods, but Israel's government says it is a "big mistake".

title_en: In Gaza, women-headed households face ‘impossible choices’ to survive
excerpt_en: In war-torn Gaza, a growing number of women-headed households face “impossible decisions” every day, amid ongoing Israeli airstrikes and still-scarce resources, UN humanitarians said on Tuesday.

title_en: Palestinian parents fear for children's lives at school as settler attacks grow
excerpt_en: A headteacher in the occupied West Bank has installed new barbed wire fencing after three pupils were killed this year.

title_en: West Bank: UN rights report warns of forcible displacement from three refugee camps
excerpt_en: Israeli security forces forcibly displaced the entire population of three Palestine refugee camps in the occupied West Bank in January and February last year – and continue to prevent their return, in violation of international law, according to a new report by the UN human rights office, OHCHR.

title_en: Lebanon–Israel tensions escalate as Gaza sees major aid delivery
excerpt_en: Peacekeepers in Lebanon have reported a marked deterioration in the security situation along the Blue Line of separation, with Israeli forces intensifying their military footprint in violation of a landmark Security Council resolution, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Thursday.

title_en: Food aid cutback in the occupied West Bank as health fears grow in Gaza
excerpt_en: Lack of funding has forced the World Food Programme (WFP) to slash aid to families in the West Bank by half even though needs have more than doubled over the past two years.

title_en: Four children killed as separate attacks in Gaza destroy aid supplies
excerpt_en: Israeli attacks killed four children and destroyed humanitarian aid supplies in what turned out to be a deadly week in war-ravaged Gaza, the UN emergency relief agency, OCHA, said on Friday.

title_en: Aid reaches hundreds of thousands in Gaza amid severe food insecurity
excerpt_en: As hunger deepens across Gaza, humanitarian agencies continue to deliver food and other essential supplies to families in need.

title_en: After Israeli seizure of Kalandia training centre, UNRWA warns of impact on youth
excerpt_en: The seizure of a vocational training centre in occupied East Jerusalem has left hundreds of Palestinian young people without access to skills and training that could help shape their futures.
